subject: Barber Shop - Appointment Slot Available!
body:
Dear $customer_name,

Great news! An appointment slot has become available!

Available Slot:
- Date: $available_date
- Time: $available_time
- Barber: $barber_name
- Service: $service_name

To book this slot, please visit the barber shop or book online as soon as possible.

This slot is available on a first-come, first-served basis, so please respond as soon as possible to secure it.

Best regards,
University Barber Shop
